verdict.rationale: Spline documents built-in AI that generates assets inside the editor: text-prompted texture generation and AI 3D generation from text or 2D images. That covers the image-generation chore in a 3D-asset form. The OpenAI API integration is a runtime interactivity feature, not an in-editor copy assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: background removal, content-aware fill, copy/text suggestions, general 2D image generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, built-in AI handles asset chores — image generation, background removal, content-aware fills, copy suggestions — inside the editor

citations.quote: Use Artificial Intelligence to generate textures like grass, concrete, wood, ceramic, and patterns just by typing!
AI 3D Generation is a new feature in Spline that allows anyone to transform textual descriptions and 2D images into 3D models with the help of AI.
The AI Agent builds and edits 3D scenes for you. Describe what you want and it does the work through the editor itself
